Reframing is a core cognitive-behavioural (CBT) technique — the approach with the strongest evidence among app-delivered tools (Linardon et al. 2024, World Psychiatry).
Anything counts — a kind word, a finished task, a decent cup of tea. Naming it makes it stick.
Writing down one good thing is the shortest form of a gratitude practice — brief, daily entries are the version with replicated effects on mood (Cregg & Cheavens 2021, Journal of Happiness Studies).
Not a to-do list — one thing that would make tomorrow feel steadier.

Naming when and what you\'ll do is an implementation intention — the step that most reliably closes the gap between intending and doing (Gollwitzer & Sheeran 2006, Advances in Experimental Social Psychology).
A DBT skill for when emotion is at a 9 or 10 and thinking feels impossible. Work the four steps in order.
Hold something cold, splash cool water on your face, or step into cooler air.
Cold triggers the dive reflex and slows your heart rate fast.
60–90 seconds of anything vigorous: star jumps, fast stairs, a brisk walk.
Burns off the adrenaline that keeps the alarm ringing.
Exhale longer than you inhale: in for 4, out for 6–8, for a minute.
Long exhales switch on the calming branch of your nervous system.
Tense a muscle group as you inhale, release completely as you exhale.
Teaches the body the difference between holding and letting go.

Guided imagery is a standard relaxation component in stress and anxiety protocols. The detail is what does the work — which is why these prompts ask about sound, light and temperature rather than just telling you to picture somewhere nice.

CereBro won\'t nag you about this. The cue is the reminder — that\'s how it works.

Deciding in advance when and where you\'ll do something — an \'if-then\' plan tied to a moment already in your day — roughly doubles follow-through compared with intention alone, across ~94 studies (Gollwitzer & Sheeran, Advances in Experimental Social Psychology, 2006).
Pick a few. Short beats thorough — a five-minute routine you keep is worth more than a twenty-minute one you skip.
